related.author: Higgsfield AI 🧩 (@higgsfield_ai)
related.text: AGI is 100% solved. Prompt: Take control of my computer using GPT-6 Astra and do the following: 1) design a character concept using Higgsfield Soul 2.0, 2) build a textured 3D model, 3) import into Blender, 4) retopologize the mesh, 5) create a UV map — full end-to-end agent pipeline demo.

related.author: Higgsfield AI 🧩 (@higgsfield_ai)
related.text: GPT-6 Astra just took over After Effects. This 20-minute screen recording shows it analyzing a reference video and recreating its motion elements to match the original timing. It puts each element in its own editable composition with a transparent background so you can reuse layers.
related.why: Astra 接管 AE，核心动效/合成工作流

related.author: Higgsfield AI 🧩 (@higgsfield_ai)
related.text: GPT-6 Astra is the strongest model for 3D game from a single prompt. We described the game in one sentence → Astra wrote drift physics, combo scoring, near-miss bonuses, speed traps, nitro → out came Street Heat, a full arcade racer running in the browser on Higgsfield Supercomputer.
related.why: Astra vibe coding / 3D 游戏，模型竞赛与智能体

related.author: Higgsfield AI 🧩 (@higgsfield_ai)
related.text: Higgsfield 3D Jutsu is rebuilding the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. This one is the Great Pyramid of Giza. GPT-6 Astra builds the geometry, then Seedance 2.5 generates the final pass, all of it on Higgsfield Supercomputer.

related.author: Generator (@groovestreetgen)
related.text: I rebuilt Bikini Bottom. Then turned it into a movie AND a playable game. Blender → GPT Image 2 → Seedance 2.5. Photoshop for the poster. Higgsfield MCP + GPT-6 Astra = AGI. 30s / 1080p unofficial AI fan concept; gameplay next.
related.why: Seedance 2.5 影视+游戏管线实操

related.author: Higgsfield AI 🧩 (@higgsfield_ai)
related.text: GPT-6 Astra is insanely good at blueprint-to-architecture. We gave it one floor plan → Astra generated the scene code → Higgsfield built the location model in Blender and rendered it with Cycles. Whole pipeline end-to-end on Higgsfield Supercomputer.
related.why: 蓝图→3D 建筑，AI 视频/动效管线

related.author: Higgsfield AI 🧩 (@higgsfield_ai)
related.text: GPT-6 Astra is color grading in DaVinci Resolve now. It took flat Apple Log 2 footage and adjusted contrast, shadows, and color to produce this final grade. Original footage, grading process, and result shown together. Made with Higgsfield + GPT-6 Astra.

related.author: Justine Moore (@venturetwins)
related.text: Incredible launch from World Labs. Atlas is a new multimodal world model that generates up to 1 minute of video with precise camera control and spatial consistency. The model takes text and image as inputs, as well as camera paths — watch the demo.

related.author: Perplexity (@perplexity_ai)
related.text: We evaluated GPT-6 Astra on WANDR. It scored 0.682 at $11.98 per task, the highest score of any model we tested. GPT-6-Astra scored 13.5% higher than Fable 5.1 at 6.1% lower cost, and 27.0% higher than Opus 5 at 3.3% higher cost.
related.why: 模型竞赛基准：Astra vs Fable/Opus

related.author: Higgsfield AI 🧩 (@higgsfield_ai)
related.text: This is a new AI video workflow in 2026: Lock your camera path, actors and timing in Blender with the Higgsfield plugin, before spending a single credit. Pre-viz first, then render — saves Seedance/credits burn.
related.why: Blender + Higgsfield 省额度工作流（书签相关）

related.author: lumxss (@bkdgiffug)
related.text: 别再怀疑用 Codex 剪视频的可靠性了，这玩法最近确实火出圈。browser-use 团队刚开源的 video-use，免费且已斩获 16.5k star。亲测后反馈这工具还省 Token：不让大模型死盯画面，而是先用 ElevenLabs Scribe 把视频压缩成一份 12KB 的时间戳文本，像改 Word 一样在文字层动刀。
related.why: 中文 AI 创作者 + Codex 视频剪辑

related.author: Geek Lite (@QingQ77)
related.text: Vicoa 把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor、Copilot、Kimi、Hermes 八种编程 Agent 收进一个工作区，每个 Agent 各占一个 git worktree 和分支，能同时改同一个仓库。开源可自托管，贴合多 Agent 编程栈。
